ttsdata.text: Man. I've been here for so damn long, I've not seen the sun in years!
All right Jared!Your sentence has ended! You're free to go!
Wait a minute, I thought that I had at least a few years to go.
Well, apparently you're getting out because of good behavior!
Well, I did make a mean sandwick!
Well, my parole officer told me to move from Jefferson County, Colorado to some place called GoAnimate City! I've never heard of it before, but whatever!
